children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Sorrento Resources Ltd.

(OTCQB: SRSLF) (the "Company" or "Sorrento"), a Canadian exploration company focused on the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral projects in Atlantic Canada, announces the resignation of Neal Blackmore as a Director of the Company. The Company wishes to thank Mr. Blackmore for his contributions to the Board and wishes him all the best in future endeavours.

Sorrento is engaged in acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral property assets in Canada. Sorrento's objective is to locate and develop economic precious and rare earth element, gold, and base metal properties of merit including the Bottom Brook Project, Rodgers Cove Gold, and Harmsworth (VMS) project all located in Newfoundland.
